meta.extraction_policy: Source-exhaustive bilingual framing from the lesson, diagrams, activities, comparison tables, ICT and evaluation. No outside facts are inserted; ambiguous source prompts are not assigned invented answers.
source_notes: Both linked Drive PDFs were used; English text supplies clean page-aligned extraction and Tamil terminology is retained in the bilingual bank.

The chapter gives more than one bacterial/prokaryotic size range in different contexts: 0.01–0.5 µm in the cell-size paragraph, 0.003–2.0 µm in the prokaryotic prose, and 1–2 µm in the comparison table. Questions preserve the context of each stated range rather than forcing one value.
The evaluation asks to arrange organism and egg lists but does not state an ordering criterion or direction. Those ambiguous sequencing prompts are not given an invented unique answer.
The evaluation clue comparing a cell part to a policeman is answered from the chapter table: the cell membrane is the gate of the cell and controls movement of materials in and out.
meta.question_style: Natural competitive-exam wording; no routine 'according to the textbook' phrasing.
meta.quality_policy: Competitive-exam useful questions only. Classroom stories, activity props, learning-objective recall, ICT steps, picture trivia and low-value procedural questions removed.
meta.quality_note: Correct-answer positions balanced to five per option in each quiz, with no repeated-answer run longer than two. English and Tamil options were moved together; original correct answer pairs are preserved.
